newsitem.title: FINLAND: SENTRA SEES WEAKER SECOND HALF RESULT.
newsitem.headline: SENTRA SEES WEAKER SECOND HALF RESULT.

text.p: Finnish retail and fast-food group Sentra Oy said in a statement on Monday it expected its result in the second half of the financial year to be weaker than in the first but the full year would still be in the black.
Its first half profit after financial items jumped to 10.1 million markka from 1.8 million.

"The profit development will be weaker in the second half due to normal seasonal seasonal fluctuation," Sentra said, adding that the result would also be hit by start-up costs of the second EuroSpar supermarket
"The group result in the full financial year is, however, expected to be positive, as targetted," it said.
Full-year net sales would be almost 800 million markka, up about 100 million on the previous financial year, it said.
